WHAT WAS ASKED — ROLE-SPECIFIC ACCOUNTS
A Software Design Intern account describes a 90-minute OA with two string/array coding questions and 20 technical MCQs, followed by technical and HR rounds. It reports a choice of C, C++, Java or Python for the coding sections.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MTkyMQ

An embedded/design-verification compilation covers SystemVerilog assertions for FIFO behavior, array initialization, FSM construction, SPI modes, clock-domain crossing and interrupt handling. These are hardware-oriented role topics, not evidence of the same test for software interns.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MTkxOQ

An SDE-1 compilation names kth-largest selection, next-greater-element and inversion counting. It describes coding interviews of differing lengths on different dates, so those durations should not be collapsed into one standard process.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MTkxOA

QUESTION PATTERNS IN OAHELPER
No matching published non-mock question records are available. A company-specific topic ranking, coding/MCQ split or difficulty distribution cannot be supported yet.

SOURCE NOTES
Compiled from OAHelper’s verified calendar, approved experiences and published question labels as of 22 September 2026. Campus labels in calendar reports can include off-campus applications; an interview author’s college is not necessarily the interview venue. Different roles, seniority levels and dates can have different processes.
